english.note: Use 直 as the all-purpose choice for something physically straight, and colloquially when “straight” means heterosexual.
Use this for the literal physical sense of being straight rather than crooked or circuitous.

examples.english: This line is drawn very straight.
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sin3 waak6 dak1 hou2 zik6

examples.english: This road is straight and direct, so there’s no need to take a detour.
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hou2 zik6 m4 sai2 dau1 lou6
